Full suite green: **26 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS**.

## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`assignCustomerCode`** now takes the city as well as the last name. It builds the code from `CITY3` (upper-cased first three letters of the city) and `LAST3` (first three of the last name), joined with a per-city 4-digit sequence — computed as one more than the number of existing owners whose city matches (case-insensitively). Extracted a small `prefix3` helper for the shared "upper-cased first three letters, null-safe" logic.
- The call site passes `owner.getCity()` alongside `owner.getLastName()`.

Everything derived from the code rebuilds automatically: the **membershipNumber** in `OwnerMapper` is already expressed as `getCustomerCode() + "-M" + <YY>`, so it now carries the city-prefixed code with no change needed there.

All three targeted acceptance tests (Cp09 per-city sequence, Cp14 membership number, Cp16 city-prefixed format) and the full 26-test suite pass.
